title: Eval fixture (two-arm comparative)
description: One comparative eval case. Runs the same task through TWO arms (library-ON, library-OFF baseline), applies a Tier-0 deterministic check to each, then a blind pairwise judge panel scores per-dimension. This schema defines the INPUT contract; result.schema.json defines the OUTPUT.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier; also the fixture filename stem and the join key into result records.

description.description: One-line statement of the capability this fixture probes.

task.description: The verbatim instruction handed to BOTH arms. Arm-specific framing lives in arms.*.prompt, not here.

output_type.description: What kind of artifact the task produces. Drives checker selection and report bucketing.

arms.description: The two producers compared. 'library' is library-ON; 'baseline' is library-OFF (vanilla agent told to use no skills/subagents).

deterministic_check.description: Tier-0 deterministic verification applied identically to BOTH arms' artifacts.

kind.description: Checker identifier the runner dispatches, e.g. 'validate.sh', 'cargo-test', 'schema-match'. Must resolve to a checker in eval/checkers/.

tier.description: Deterministic checks are Tier 0 by definition; this is the only tier permitted to gate.

gates.description: Whether a deterministic failure disqualifies the arm. Tier-0 checks may gate; the comparative report still records both arms' pass/fail regardless.

spec.description: Optional human-readable description of how the checker is staged and what PASS means.

patterns.description: For kind=schema-match: required grep -E patterns (or jq:<filter>) the artifact must contain. The runner passes these to the checker; without them schema-match exits 2 (skip).

rubric.description: The per-dimension scoring rubric the blind pairwise judge panel applies. Tier-2: informs the report, never gates.

note.description: Posture note for judges, e.g. default-reject / score conservatively when evidence is weak.

dimensions.description: Independent quality axes. Each is judged as a pairwise winner+margin between the two arms.

arm.description: One producer. 'kind' says how the artifact is produced; agentType/prompt configure it.

kind.description: 'agent' dispatches a single named agent; 'pod' runs a v2-collab collaboration pod.

agentType.description: For kind=agent: the agent to dispatch (e.g. 'engineer' for library-ON, 'general-purpose' for baseline). Omitted for kind=pod.

prompt.description: Optional arm-specific instruction prepended to the shared task. The baseline arm uses this to forbid skills/subagents.

note.description: Rationale / pluggability note for maintainers. Not handed to the producer.

key.description: snake_case dimension identifier; the join key into the judge's per_dimension results.

max.description: Maximum points for this dimension. Used to normalize margins into a comparable scale.

asks.description: The concrete question the judge answers for this dimension — specific enough to discriminate, not trigger-soup.
